Due to a permanent communication blackout, no direct flight corridor exists between Hub Alpha and Hub Beta.  
Furthermore, owing to overlapping frequency bands, the route must incorporate exactly one of the following two critical links: the corridor between Hub Beta and Hub Gamma, or the corridor between Hub Gamma and Hub Delta.  

The objective is to determine the minimal total flight distance for a closed circuit that visits every hub precisely once and returns to the origin hub.
